# ── Actuators ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
actuators = []
for act in root.iter():
    if act.tag in ("position", "velocity", "motor", "general"):
        name  = act.get("name", "")
        joint = act.get("joint", "")
        rng   = act.get("ctrlrange", "")
        lo, hi = (float(v) for v in rng.split()) if rng else (None, None)
        actuators.append({"name": name, "joint": joint, "ctrlrange": [lo, hi]})
        print(f"  actuator: {name:25s}  joint={joint:25s}  ctrlrange=[{lo},{hi}]")

print(f"\nTotal actuators: {len(actuators)}")

# ── Sites ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\nSites:")
for s in root.iter("site"):
    print(f"  site: {s.get('name')}  pos={s.get('pos')}")

# ── Free-joint bodies (graspable) ────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\nFree-joint bodies:")
graspable = []
for fj in root.iter("freejoint"):
    parent = None
    for body in root.iter("body"):
        if fj in list(body):
            parent = body.get("name")
            break
    graspable.append(parent)
    print(f"  {parent}")

# ── Equality constraints ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\nEquality constraints:")
for eq in root.iter("equality"):
    for child in eq:
        print(f"  {child.tag}: body1={child.get('body1')} body2={child.get('body2')} active={child.get('active')}")

def print_tree(el, indent=0):
    if el.tag == "body":
        print("  " * indent + f"body: {el.get('name','?')}")
        for child in el:
            print_tree(child, indent + 1)

wb = root.find("worldbody")
print_tree(wb)
